permission.servicesOffBody: Turn on location services for your device so OSY can follow your position and speed.
permission.requestBody: OSY uses your location and speed while the app is open to warn you about road risks. Motion access helps it notice a crash.
permission.deniedBody: OSY cannot show your position or speed without location access.
permission.limitedBody: OSY is using your approximate location, so speed and road details may be wrong.
permission.motionRequestBody: Motion access helps OSY notice a crash. Location still works without it.
permission.motionDeniedBody: Location still works, but OSY will not be able to use motion to notice a crash.

background.title: Keep crash detection on
background.body: OSY needs your location all the time to notice a crash while your phone is locked or another app is open. It runs at full power only while you drive, and your location is not recorded.

preferences.description: Make OSY work for your drive.
preferences.saveError: Could not save preferences. Please try again.
preferences.alertsHint: These control notifications. An active emergency check-in always remains accessible.
preferences.detectionHint: Higher sensitivity can produce more false alarms. Monitoring also follows your Home Pause/Resume control.
preferences.countdownHint: Applies to the next check-in. The three stages share this total; a running emergency keeps its original timing.
preferences.voiceUnavailable: Voice requires an updated development build and a device speech engine.
preferences.browserPermissions: Manage permissions in your browser’s site settings.
preferences.dataSharingHint: Allow optional driving analytics on the backend. Essential location, reporting and emergency services still use the data they need.
preferences.medicalSharing: Share medical info in an emergency
preferences.medicalSharingHint: Opt in to sharing your saved medical profile with responders through the backend.
preferences.deleteHint: Deletion requires a connection. Saved reports, medical info, contacts, local pending data and caches are removed. Deleting the account also removes your identity.
preferences.deleteOnline: Connect to the internet to confirm deletion.
preferences.emergencyActive: Finish the active emergency before deleting your data.
preferences.deleteError: Deletion could not be completed. Please reconnect and try again.

account.signOutHint: Your profile, medical information and emergency contacts will be removed from this phone. Sign in again to download them.
